# IPoolPermissionManager
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/syrup/IPoolPermissionManager.sol)

**Title:**
IPoolPermissionManager

Interface for the Maple Syrup pool permission manager controlling lender access


## Functions
### lenderAllowlist

Returns whether a lender is on a pool's allowlist


```solidity
function lenderAllowlist(address poolManager, address lender) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`poolManager`|`address`|The pool manager address|
|`lender`|`address`|The lender to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if the lender is allowlisted|


### hasPermission

Returns whether a lender holds a specific permission for a pool


```solidity
function hasPermission(address poolManager, address lender, bytes32 permission) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`poolManager`|`address`|The pool manager address|
|`lender`|`address`|The lender to check|
|`permission`|`bytes32`|The permission identifier|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if the lender has the permission|
